info.title: AuraPix Host Webhook Event Catalog API
info.description: Machine-readable catalog of every metering / webhook event AuraPix can emit. Hosts integrating AuraPix for billing fetch this once at boot, cache it via `ETag`, and use the per-event JSON Schema to validate incoming webhook payloads. The same `catalogVersion` is stamped on every outbound webhook envelope (`HostWebhookSink`) so hosts can detect drift without polling. Issue #176.

get.summary: Return the global catalog of metering / webhook event types
get.description:
Returns every event type AuraPix can emit, with JSON Schema for the `meta` payload and a `catalogVersion` cache key.

The catalog is **global** — identical for every host — and is safely cacheable at the edge. Hosts SHOULD send `If-None-Match` with the previously received `ETag` to get a `304` when nothing has changed.

Auth: any valid host API key (`Authorization: Bearer ak_live_...`). No specific scope is required because the body contains no per-tenant data; the auth gate exists only to keep the roadmap out of fully-anonymous hands.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Previously received ETag. A match returns 304 with no body.

200.description: Catalog body. The `ETag` header is a weak validator derived from `catalogVersion` and a hash of the body.

Cache-Control.description: Aggressive caching is enabled by default (`public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=600`).

304.description: Catalog unchanged since the supplied `If-None-Match`. No body.

401.description: Missing or invalid host API key

catalogVersion.description: Bumped whenever the set of event types changes (new event, removed event, or non-additive schema change). Hosts compare against the cached snapshot and the per-envelope `catalogVersion` field.

version.description: Per-event schema version. Bumped on non-additive meta changes.

billable.description: Hint that this event maps to a unit of resold work. Not a contract; hosts decide their own billing rules.

schema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) describing the `meta` payload for this event. Additional properties are always allowed for forward compatibility.

oneOf.description: Legacy shorthand error string from upstream auth middleware.
